er connection and configuration issues\n- [Error code reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md): What eve
ry MCPJam Inspector error code means, the likely causes, and the next step to fix it.\n- [Changelog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/chang
elog/overview.md): Track the latest updates, features, and improvements to MCPJam Inspector\n- [Home](https://docs.mcpjam.com/insp
ector/home.md): Org-scoped dashboard with activity stats, recommended servers, and quick-start clients\n- [Clients](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/inspector/clients.md): Reusable MCP client configurations for testing servers and apps under realistic conditions\n- [Mu
lti-server connections](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/connecting-servers.md): Connect to multiple MCP servers with different t
ransport methods\n- [Projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/projects.md): Group your MCP servers into projects, with the abil
ity to share them with your team\n- [Plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/plugins.md): Import Agent Plugins 1.0 bundles as v
ersioned, read-only projections of their skills and MCP servers\n- [MCP protocol versions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/proto
col-versions.md): Pin the inspector to a specific MCP protocol version — including the 2026-07-28 stateless RC — to test how your
server behaves across versions.\n- [Host Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-compat.md): See which hosts your MC
P server will work in — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, Codex Desktop — the moment you connect\n- [Skills](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/inspector/skills.md): Load and use skills to give your agents the context they need to use MCP tools effectively\n- [Playground
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/playground.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand, render widgets, and inspect
every step — all in one IDE-style workspace\n- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test cases for your
MCP server, run them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.\n- [Compatibility](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/compatibility.md): Check whether your MCP server works on each AI host — conformance gates, per-
host findings, and live widget rendering.\n- [View origins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/view-origins.md): Which origin your
MCP App's view runs at, and how to allowlist it with a third-party API\n- [Contribute a Host](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/ho
st-templates.md): Add a new host preset to MCPJam so widgets can render under that host's identity, capabilities, and sandbox poli
cy.\n- [OAuth Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/guided-oauth.md): Debug your MCP server's OAuth implementation at every
step of the handshake\n- [XAA Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/xaa-debugger.md): Configure and debug Cross-App Access f
lows with MCPJam as the test identity provider and client/agent\n- [Mid-session sign-in](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/lazy-au
thentication.md): Test servers that let you connect without signing in and ask for sign-in only when a protected call needs it\n-
[MCP Inspector](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/tools-prompts-resources.md): Manually test your MCP server's tools, resources, a
nd prompts\n- [Events and Triggers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/events.md): Inspect a server's MCP Events, subscribe to them
, and run an agent when they arrive\n- [Tracing & debugging](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/debugging.md): See all messages sen
t to and from your MCP server\n- [Telemetry & privacy](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/telemetry-privacy.md): What the Inspector
sends to analytics and error reporting, how links that act as credentials are kept out of it, and how to opt out\n- [Launch from
Code (Beta)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/launch-from-code.md): Programmatically launch and configure MCPJam Inspector from y
our code or build tools\n- [MCP Docs Server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/docs-server.md): Connect AI applications to MCPJam
documentation\n- [My First MCP App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-mcp-app.md): Build a simple Reservation MCP App from scra
tch\n- [My First ChatGPT App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-chatgpt-app-react.md): Build a simple Coffee Shop ChatGPT App w
ith React\n- [CLI Overview](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md): Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: probing, debugging, OAut
h, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal\n- [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md): Command-p
ath and flag changes when account-bound mcpjam commands moved under mcpjam cloud\n- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/loca
l-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity\n- [MCPJam a
s an MCP Server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server.md): Run MCPJam as a local stdio MCP server so agents can connect to, exer
cise, and debug other MCP servers\n- [Server Inspection](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md): Probe, diagnose, and e
xport MCP server connectivity and capabilities\n- [OAuth Conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance.md): Test your
MCP server's OAuth implementation across all registration methods and protocol versions\n- [OAuth Login & Debugging](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-login.md): Authenticate with MCP servers and debug OAuth flows\n- [XAA Debugger (CLI)](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/cli/xaa.md): Run the full Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) grant chain against your authorization server and MCP server, headlessly, f
rom one command\n- [MCP Apps Conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/apps-conformance.md): Validate MCP Apps tool metadata and ui
:// resource wiring from the CLI\n- [MCP Tasks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tasks.md): Create, inspect, answer and watch MCP Tasks
from the CLI — legacy 2025-11-25 and the SEP-2663 extension\n- [MCP Tasks Conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tasks-conforma
nce.md): Validate MCP Tasks wire behavior — legacy and SEP-2663 extension — from the CLI\n- [MCP Events](https://docs.mcpjam.com/c
li/events.md): List, poll, watch, subscribe to and conformance-check MCP Events (triggers) from the CLI: push, poll and webhook de
livery, judged by the draft or the ChatGPT profile\n- [Tools, Resources & Prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-pro
mpts.md): List, read, and call MCP server tools, resources, and prompts\n- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP h
ealth checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and other CI environments\n- [Self-hosted MCPJam](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md): Point the CLI and SDK at your organization's MCPJam server, lock it with an IT settings fil
e, and work behind a corporate proxy\n- [CLI Telemetry](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md): Anonymous command-level telemet
ry, opt-outs, and debug mode\n- [Command Reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md): Complete flag reference for every m
cpjam CLI command\n- [@mcpjam/sdk](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/index.md): MCP server unit testing, end-to-end (e2e) testing, and s
erver evals\n- [Quickstart](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/quickstart.md): Get started with @mcpjam/sdk in 5 minutes\n- [Migrating to
SDK 9.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/migrating-to-v9.md): What changed in @mcpjam/sdk 9.0, and how to upgrade from 8.x.\n- [Migra
ting to SDK 3.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/migrating-to-v3.md): What changed, why a passing test can start failing, and how to u
pgrade.\n- [Connecting to MCP Servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/connecting-servers.md): Learn how to connect to local
and remote MCP servers\n- [Testing with LLMs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/testing-with-llms.md): Use HostRunner to run pr
ompts and inspect tool calls\n- [Running Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/running-evals.md): Measure tool accuracy with
statistical evaluations\n- [Reliable evals in CI](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/enterprise-evals.md): Bound execution, pre
serve evidence, and distinguish an eval verdict from successful reporting.\n- [The User-Value Chain](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/c
oncepts/user-value-chain.md): Which link of the chain each check you write measures\n- [Save Results to MCPJam](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/sdk/concepts/saving-results.md): Save eval results to the MCPJam dashboard with an MCPJam API key (sk_…) for tracking and CI
